title: Final review of the xte diff
description:
Review the epic's full diff and resolve or route every finding before close-out unblocks.

Two things to weigh beyond the usual, because they are what this epic could plausibly get wrong:
  - Is there any path by which the container still starts a claude process? The operator constraint is absolute, and hn0 reached the wrong worker not by deciding to but by inheriting a default. Look for the inherited default, not for an explicit choice.
  - Does anything block waiting for an attempt to finish? A handle that is polled in a loop inside a dispatch is a wall clock wearing a handle's clothes.
